messages:
maya: quick mid-quarter check — can we call out shipped vs slipped for OKR: runtime v3 rollout? please include owner + next action.
raj: shipped: batching heuristics + kv-cache hotfix landed last week. owner: raj. next: monitor perf for 48h, will post metrics. :rocket:
olivia: slipped: dedicated capacity autoscale rules — ran into a race when scaling down, blocked by infra change. owner: olivia. ETA update: aiming EOW.
chris: confirmed the downscale race. root cause: node eviction + GC pause. patch in review, need one more code review. tagging @olivia and @raj for any config overlap.
maya: thanks. can we call out CR owners so we don't bottleneck?
raj: CRs: PR #3489 open — reviewers: olivia, chris. quick note in PR about the perf test harness to speed review.
olivia: I'll review PR #3489 today after stand. If LGTM, will merge and kick canary.
chris: deploy-bot: canary started on shard-2.
deploy-bot: canary: shard-2 | image: runtime:v3-20260320 | status: running | started_by: olivia
maya: great — who owns rollback plan if latency spikes?
raj: i'll own quick rollback script and health-check override. adding to the PR description.
olivia: dependency: we need the new autoscale policy from infra config repo (chris) — without it we may see repeated scale flaps. chris: creating branch with policy tweak, will link.
chris: linked: repo infra/autoscale policy branch: https://git.internal/infra/auto/policy/edge-fix — review welcome.
maya: can someone do a short async status update in 2h with canary metrics (p50/p95, errors)? keeps product stakeholders happy.
raj: will post p50/p95 + token cost diff once KV warmup completes (~30m).
olivia: if metrics look good i'll schedule a canary expansion to shard-5 and ping eng-oncall.
maya: last ask: ownership for the postmortem if we see regressions — assign to olivia+raj for a joint writeup.
raj: ack. olm/olivia for writeup, i'll add perf graphs and test logs.
maya: perfect. tagging owners list: @raj, @olivia, @chris. thanks all. :thumbsup:
chris: small followup — code review ping to @olivia on infra PR, please prioritize since it's the last blocker for autoscale.
olivia: noted, scheduling review now.
maya: closing this thread — drop any blockers below or DM me if you need help.
raj: one last FYI — CR queue: PG-2 priority for this one, bumping.
olivia: merging PR in 15 if no objections.
deploy-bot: canary metrics update: shard-2 | p50: 42ms | p95: 118ms | errors: 0.2% | token-cost-delta: -5% (KV warmup ongoing)
maya: that's promising. will update product board and roll into the OKR tracker.
